doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

title: Photo of La Rocca's group in Chicago
summary: They look at a photograph of La Rocca with Nunez, before Shields joined, with a Chicago studio mark.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask some more about the funerals. See?
There's the band. There's what they got.
Let's look at the picture first then. That's the picture. That's the group with Nick LaRocca. Yeah.
That's what you got here. And Tony, yes.
I think we saw that before when Johnny Wiggs was here. Yeah. Tony and Eddie Edwards.
Tony and Edwards. Tony and Eddie Edwards. LaRocca Nunes.
That's the... Or the Ragus. That's Yellow Nunes there, not Shields this time. Yellow Nunes, yeah. That's before Shields joined then. Yeah. What was that tape?

It says Chicago down here, I think, yes, on the picture. Some studio in Chicago. Yes, yeah. Yeah, I can't make out. L-A-G-U-E-R-R-E. French or Italian name or something. Used a piano, is that? An old style upright piano. He only used one Chinese symbol. Well, I was going to ask some more about those funerals. On the way back from the graveyard, did you still play slow music or what kind of music?
